cases.description: PendulumLab physics, headless (catalog Y01 units): the sample's REAL PendulumService TU compiled in-exe, registered with CS_SERVICE and driven by a ServiceHost on a DataBus at 1/240 s: undamped small-angle RK4 vs the analytic F-PENDULUM reference (tests/fixtures/ap04/pendulum_reference.csv, generated by the checked-in script) within 1e-4 rad over 10 s; monotone energy decrease with c = 0.05 (both models) and the damped reference within 1e-4; zero-crossing period estimate within 1 % of 2 pi sqrt(L/g), L read from the bus (L = 4 doubles T); two runs bit-identical (FNV-1a over the published angle series); start/stop/reset/nudge signals; the PhasePlot CS_PANEL registration with its call site.

PendulumLab flow driven headlessly (catalog F02 U): the sample's own flows/Main.cflow, scenes and screen scripts under a minimal PlayerLayer loop (services BindScene before scripts Instantiate, fixed tick before the variable tick): Home -(start_clicked)-> Lab (LabScreen starts the service; the rig sprites follow the bus) -(key:Escape via FlowKeyBridge)-> Home; Lab -(settings_clicked)-> Settings -(back_clicked)-> Lab; `when pendulum.energy < 0.01` pushes the Stopped overlay and resume_clicked pops it with the StoppedScreen re-release so the guard does not re-arm; a scripted 200-step sequence gives the same state trace on two runs.

Template content, headless (contract sections 3, 5, 8): every template / sample / PendulumLab scene loads through SceneSerializer with the expected entities and component names (widgets pending AP-02 through the serializer's verbatim-preservation path, live components with reflected-field validation once registered), one primary camera per scene (orthographic + Canvas on section-5 screens), every widget field name from the contract, sibling rules, non-empty button signals; the app template's and PendulumLab's flows validate and name only screens that exist (Escape edge, @quit, the channel-guarded `when`); every template carries kind, the CS_SCREENS markers and the token only in text; the game template's and the app template's scripts compile with their defaults; the app template's AppService publishes app.uptime/app.sine/app.counter and handles counter.increment/counter.reset/settings.defaults.
